entries.definitionCN: 神圣的、宗教的；只是发音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: good for health or moral wellbeing
entries.definitionCN: 有益健康的、正派的；同含 whole 形，但构词来源不同

entries.definition: combined so that the parts work as one
entries.definitionCN: 整合的；各部分合为一体的

entries.definition: covering all or nearly all of something
entries.definitionCN: 全面的；包罗广泛的，强调范围齐全

entries.definition: relating to a whole system
entries.definitionCN: 系统的；全身的，强调作用于整个系统

entries.definition: explaining things by separate units
entries.definitionCN: 原子论的；把事物拆成独立单元的，为 holistic 的反义取向

entries.definition: simplifying something too far
entries.definitionCN: 简化过度的；还原论的

normalIntro.en: Holistic carries the Greek word for whole, so it always leans towards the complete picture.
normalIntro.cn: holistic 里藏着希腊语的「整个」，所以它总是偏向完整的图景。

normal.en: Holos means whole in Greek, and holism is the noun built on it.
normal.cn: holos 在希腊语中意为「整个」，holism 就是由它构成的名词。

normal.en: The -istic ending marks a method or standpoint, as in holistic approach.
normal.cn: 词尾 -istic 表示方法或立场，如 holistic approach。

normal.en: A holistic assessment looks at all parts at once, like a doctor checking diet and sleep together.
normal.cn: holistic assessment 一次看全部环节，好比医生同时问饮食与睡眠。

normal.en: Holism pairs with atomism as whole pairs with part.
normal.cn: holism 与 atomism 相对，正如整体与部分相对。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with holy: both look alike but only one means whole.
normal.cn: 别与 holy 混淆：两者形似，但只有前者表示「整个」。

abstract.en: Picture one hand holding up an entire finished jigsaw puzzle.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手托起一整幅拼好的拼图。

abstract.en: Think of looking down on a forest from a hill instead of counting single trees.
abstract.cn: 想象从山丘上俯瞰整片森林，而不是一棵一棵地数树。

abstract.en: Imagine writing a report that lists body, mind and home as one single column.
abstract.cn: 想象写报告时把身体、心理和家庭放进同一个栏目。

examples.en: Teachers now use a holistic approach that values both skills and confidence.
examples.cn: 教师如今采用一种兼顾技能与自信的整体方法。

examples.en: Some farmers prefer holistic planning, considering soil, water and profit together.
examples.cn: 一些农民偏好整体规划，把土壤、水和收益放在一起考虑。

examples.en: A sudden change in temperature is best explained by a holistic model, not by a single factor.
examples.cn: 气温骤变用整体模型解释最合适，而非归因于单一因素。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「合力」——各部分合力才成为一个整体；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 holos（整个、完整）+ 英语构词成分 -istic（具有……性质的）；先有名词 holism（整体论），再由它造出形容词 holistic。

sensesIntro.en: Holistic starts from the philosophical claim that the whole comes first, moves into medicine and care, then into any assessment that covers all aspects.
sensesIntro.cn: holistic 从「整体优先」的哲学主张出发，进入医疗与照护，再扩展到任何涵盖全部方面的评估。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand holding a whole puzzle rather than one piece.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手托起整幅拼图，而不是只拿一块。

branches.en: The basic sense treats the object as one complete whole.
branches.cn: 最基本的义项把对象当作一个完整的整体。

branches.en: Caring for the whole person is the medical sense.
branches.cn: 照护整个的人是医疗义项。

branches.en: Covering every aspect is the ordinary evaluative sense.
branches.cn: 涵盖每个方面是日常评价义项。

branches.en: The philosophical theory of holism gives the technical sense.
branches.cn: 整体论的理论背景给出专业义项。

branches.en: Systems and ecology explain behaviour by wholes.
branches.cn: 系统与生态学用整体解释行为。

intro.en: Holistic is built from a Greek root, a noun-forming suffix and an adjective suffix; no Latin elements are involved.
intro.cn: holistic 由希腊词根、名词词缀和形容词词缀构成，构件中并无拉丁成分。

latinIntro.en: The word family comes through Greek rather than Latin; the comparison entries below are Greek forms kept for reference.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词族经由希腊语而非拉丁语而来；下面列出的是供对照参考的希腊语形式。

items.example: Holos is the root of this family.
items.exampleCN: holos 是这个词族的词根。

items.example: The suffix -ism forms holism.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ism 构成 holism。

items.meaning: the theory that the whole is primary
items.meaningCN: 整体论；认为整体优先的理论
items.example: Holism shaped debates in early biology.
items.exampleCN: 整体论影响了早期生物学的争论。

items.meaning: a person who holds a theory
items.meaningCN: 表示信奉某理论者的后缀
items.example: The suffix -ist forms holist.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ist 构成 holist。

items.meaning: relating to a theory or manner
items.meaningCN: 表示「与某理论或方式有关的」
items.example: The suffix -istic forms holistic.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -istic 构成 holistic。

items.meaningCN: 整体的；全面考虑各部分的
items.example: Holistic views treat relation as central.
items.exampleCN: 整体观把相互关系视为核心。

items.example: Doctors reviewed the case holistically.
items.exampleCN: 医生们从整体上审阅了这个病例。

items.example: A holist rejects single-cause answers.
items.exampleCN: 整体论者拒绝单一原因的解释。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 整个的；完整的，供对照的希腊语词根

latinEntries.structure: Greek root in an English noun
latinEntries.meaningCN: 作为单位的整体，是 holism 的词根来源
